title: Footnote macro profile with batched ParentTree enabled

method.compilation: one direct tagged LuaHBTeX pass with populated .aux/.toc and no .out
method.instrumentation: Lua os.clock around every \footnote call, preserving the original xparse optional argument

limits: One profile pass; macro intervals include nested link and tagpdf work and are not additive with other macro profiles.
Lua os.clock timing is not overhead-corrected.
This is not a paired comparison to the previous 45.916-second profile; ParentTree batching and seed state differ.
A direct pass is not the converged production export.
decision: Footnote processing remains measurable at 33.115 CPU seconds, about 15.4% of the direct pass. Profile the remaining link macros and avoid changing production footnote rendering until a candidate is measured and semantically audited.
